summary: [deterministic] all deterministic checks passed for engineering-openclaw-sandbox-blueprint | [judge] [fallback from codex] New test chat_fallback_returns_ok_when_no_chat_command at line 2129 correctly exercises the no-CHAT_COMMAND fallback path through send_session_message. It sets up auth, creates a session, sends a message without any OPENCLAW_VARIANT_*_CHAT_COMMAND env var, and asserts 200 OK with {"ok": true}. The fallback logic (lines 1172-1178) returns an informative string instead of erroring. cargo test --workspace passes with 0 failures.

findings.title: Test does not assert fallback message content
findings.body: The test checks status 200 and body["ok"]==true but does not inspect the assistant message text to confirm it contains the expected fallback string ('Chat bridge is not configured for variant...'). This means a regression that silently swallows the fallback and returns empty text would not be caught.
findings.evidence: Line 2220-2223: only asserts status and ok field, not message content from the session store

findings.title: No negative case for missing text part
findings.body: The handler returns BadRequest when the message has no non-empty text part (line 1153). This adjacent path is not tested here, but is out of scope for the stated goal.
findings.evidence: Line 1153: ok_or_else(|| ApiError::BadRequest("message requires a non-empty text part"))
